page.layout: One block of text in a single column, with a woodcut ornament at the head of the page above the text. No margin notes, no running head, no catchword. Page number at the foot: "Q 2" as a signature, and the catchword "duxi," at the right, which is part of the last line of text. Signature "Q 2" at the foot left.

main_text.p: Qui in peregrinas regiones amandantur, si occasio ita ferat commodaad parentes & patronos aliquid fructuum novorum aut aliarum rerum insignium obviarum mittere solent. Vestro beneficio ego cum aliis quibusdam popularibus in hanc schola confirmandi imprimis studii theologici gratia ablegatus fui. Ut hinc aliud aliquid, quam quod ad studia pertineat ad vos destinem non finit mea erga vos observantia: ut nempe intelligatis, id mihi & caeteris curae esse, quod vestra auctoritate jussistis. Quum vero noveritis, patres multum colendi, exercitatione multa opus esse, ut etiam mediocritatem aliquam in optimis literis aslequamur: non debui praeceptoribus refragari qui me etiam in publicum prodire nunc volebant. Suscepi igitur hanc de amplitudine ecclesiae disputationem, quam advos mittendam duxi,

page.notes: Transcription is of the single printed page shown. Text reads "Qui in peregrinas regiones amandantur, si occasio ita ferat commodaad parentes..." with the printed run-together "commodaad" as printed; the printed line break after "commoda" is ad parentes. Doubtful words: "obviarum" and "aslequamur" appear as printed; "aliarum" and "obviarum" are read from the scan with some uncertainty. The letter "f" in "fructuum" and "fui" is a long s as printed (f in long-s form) and is rendered with s/f as the scan shows: "fructuum", "ftudia" etc. Show-through and stains omitted. The woodcut ornament is not transcribed. Words in italic: "de amplitudine ecclesiae". Catchword "duxi," is at the foot right on the last line; it is part of the running text and is kept in place. Printing errors left as printed, including "vestro" and "scholā", "quam advos".
